query:
SELECT weekNumber, SUM(headcount) as total_headcount
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber = 20
  AND (subgroup = 'Adults' OR subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In' OR subgroup = 'Revolution Jasper Check-In' OR subgroup = 'Revolution Church Jasper' OR subgroup = 'Kids')
GROUP BY weekNumber;
